question: Estimate the number of people who travel by Indian Railways daily.
idealClarificationQuestions: Daily passenger trips (each boarding = one trip)? Yes.
Both reserved + unreserved + suburban + metro under IR? All including suburban.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Annual rail passenger trips (FY26 estimate): ~750-800 crore.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: - Suburban (Mumbai locals, Chennai EMU, Kolkata): ~80 lakh/day.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: - Reserved (mail/express, Vande Bharat, Rajdhani, Shatabdi): ~30 lakh/day.

calculationFlow: Annual rail passenger trips (FY26 estimate): ~750-800 crore.
